items.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019
items.q: I had the opportunity for a number of years to direct a big band, the Aspen Festival. And we’d have, you know Joe Williams came and Clark Terry, and I had great people that came out

ctx.x: You mentioned a guy from, you know upstate New York had a lot of great musicians come out of here, mostly Italians, like the Romanos and the Brignolas. You mentioned Nick Brignola. And man he could play that horn.

He was amazing. I loved the way he played. I had the opportunity for a number of years to direct a big band, the Aspen Festival. And we’d have, you know Joe Williams came and Clark Terry, and I had great people that came out, it was really a privileged position, it was wonderful. And Nick came out, I had him come out one time and he was just great with the band, just nailed it, wowed everybody with his showmanship and his improvisation.
